purpose: Cross-phase register for unresolved, deferred, future-scope, or product-level observations discovered during phase execution and Operator validation.

governanceRule.summary: Phase Observation Registers record where observations are discovered and triaged. The Project Observation Register records observations that must remain visible across phase boundaries.
governanceRule.phaseCloseoutRequirement: Every phase closeout must confirm all phase observations are Resolved, No action required, or represented in the Project Observation Register.

openObservations.title: Validation checklist should become editable / structured
openObservations.sourceArtifact: Phase 03 Observation Register; WC04/WC05/WC06 validation observations
openObservations.operatorObservation: The manual validation checklist should move to the top of the Operator validation record, become editable, or become pass/fail/skipped questions so the validation record does not duplicate What was tested and checklist content.
openObservations.dispositionRationale: This is durable validation UX debt. It is not specific to one Work Card and should remain visible until the validation-record creation flow is repaired or redesigned.
openObservations.assignedTarget: WC12 — Operator Validation Record and REPAIR Sub-Card Route, or post-Phase-03 validation UX cleanup if WC12 scope is kept narrower.

openObservations.title: Screenshot paste and evidence UI needs cleanup
openObservations.sourceArtifact: Phase 03 Observation Register; WC04 repair validation observations
openObservations.operatorObservation: Screenshot paste should be the primary input method, the attach button should be fallback, repo-relative paths should clear after image creation, and screenshot evidence should be shown more like an image/card rather than long path text.
openObservations.dispositionRationale: This is broader validation evidence UX, not limited to a single Work Card. It should remain visible across phases until addressed.
openObservations.assignedTarget: WC12 — Operator Validation Record and REPAIR Sub-Card Route, or post-Phase-03 UI cleanup.

openObservations.title: Multi-project / workspace support does not exist
openObservations.sourceWorkCard: WC05 — Subordinate Navigation and Manual Fallback Preservation
openObservations.operatorObservation: There is no way currently to work multiple projects through the application.
openObservations.architectDisposition: Transfer to product backlog / future phase.
openObservations.dispositionRationale: Multi-project/workspace management is valid product functionality but outside Phase 03 router UI correction. It must not disappear at Phase 03 closeout.

openObservations.title: Top workflow/action bars and Supporting Tools are duplicative and consume workspace real estate
openObservations.sourceWorkCard: WC07-REPAIR01 — Artifact Workspace Layout Ownership and Preview Usability
openObservations.operatorObservation: Action bar remains duplicative and cluttered. Supporting Tools menu is duplicative of the action bar. Action bar should be collapsible or minimizable in some way to return real estate to the workspace.
openObservations.dispositionRationale: This is a valid global navigation/readability issue. It was not a WC07-REPAIR01 blocker because WC07-REPAIR01 repaired artifact workspace layout ownership, not the global workflow/action bar system. It affects workspace real estate and should be considered before creating additional route-specific screens.
openObservations.assignedTarget: Later Phase 03 navigation/layout cleanup Work Card, WC08 if scope aligns, or post-Phase-03 UI consolidation pass.
